design.question: naming accuracy on real C-ArmLSpine frames against the number of in-domain training cases, per view protocol
design.folds: five case-grouped folds, tools/carmlspine_to_bank.py rule: md5(case) % 5 == K test, (K+1) % 5 val (checkpoint selection), the rest the training pool; test and val fixed across N
design.N_100: not drawable: the largest training pool is 96 cases (fold 1); N = all is 84-96 cases per fold
design.subsets: nested: the committed shuffled order (random.Random(1000*K + seed) over the sorted pool, SchwingNet/results/indomain/fill/naming_subsets.json), filtered to cases whose fold bank holds >= 1 training crop of the protocol (revision 2, 2026-09-24; revision 1 filtered on a meta frame and 42 cells could not be built), first N
design.views: LAT or AP: training and selection crops of that protocol only; every cell scored on both protocols
design.recipe: slurm/carmlspine_cv_v9.sh (A12) verbatim except training cases and seed: init ~/allspine_v9_fov96_ctx/runs/model_rung_1_aug2.pt; base = the v9 per-class-600 sample (merge_banks seed 0 cache, rebuilt because ~/carm_base_cache_v9 is a truncated file from a job cancelled mid-write); merge_banks --real-share 0.5; train_level_classifier --epochs 15 --lr 1e-4 --augment 2 --seed s --uint8-resident (identical arithmetic, a quarter of the host memory); head_mixed_length --train-mode mixed --seed s
design.zeroshot: v9 encoder + head_allspine_v9_mixed_kmax4_seed0 (no C-arm image, not even for selection)
design.ood: film: LAT = BUU lateral lumbar + NHANES lateral lumbar films from the v9 bank (built from ~/films_drr, lateral films only); AP = BUU-LSPINE AP films of v9 TRAIN-split BUU persons, cropped with v9's settings (apfilm, added 2026-09-24). render: physics_drr CT renders of the same view. Both arms: v9 TRAIN-split persons, levels restricted to those the C-arm crops carry, N persons = the in-domain cell's case count, crops cut round-robin over the persons to the in-domain cell's crop count, so the mix's repeat factor is the same; selection on the same C-arm val fold
design.scoring: tools/level_prototype.py --no-orient --flag (no flag models) with the film keypoint detector detector_v5z_final (never saw a C-arm frame); tools/carmlspine_eval.py score; exact level of detector-matched vertebrae at full coverage (abstentions scored on their name); kfull, k3, k1
design.held_out: tools/eval_gate.py runs inside level_prototype (every model's chain vs every test image's patient); plus the list intersection recorded per cell (heldout_lists)

caveats: N = 100 is not drawable: a fold's training pool holds 82-96 usable cases, so N = all is 82-96 (x_persons_per_fold).

The zero-shot row is the N = 0 reference. The in-domain N = 0 row (the fine-tune recipe with no C-arm training crop, checkpoint picked on the C-arm val fold) reads LOWER than zero-shot on AP (see contrasts), so fine-tuning on the base sample alone does not help.

Zero-shot here is the clean v9 level model: AP whole frame 43.9 % (278/633) [35.7, 52.3]. The 37.9 % (239/631) quoted in INVENTORY.md/a3 is allspine_v2_r1 (a bank that leaked people between its splits) on the pre-repair truth; they are different models and item sets.
Every fine-tuned arm, the film and render arms included, picks its checkpoint on the C-ArmLSpine val fold of its protocol (disjoint from the test fold). The arms differ only in their training images.

The film and render arms ran at seed 0 only. The in-domain seed spread at small N is in checks.seed_spread_pct (e.g. AP whole frame N=5: 91.5, 91.6, 89.3 %), so a film-vs-C-arm gap of a few points at one N is inside seed noise.

The BUU AP films and the CT renders carry L1-L5 crops and no sacrum crop; the C-arm crops carry the sacrum too. The test items are vertebra boxes only (tools/carmlspine_eval.py, cls == 0), so scoring is unaffected; the training mix differs.

case121, case34, case42 have no labeller-agreed vertebra level (only a clipped sacrum box), so they are never a training case and contribute no test item. case42 and case121 are two of the three real L6 patients.
The lateral film curve is not monotone (N = 50 dips); one seed per point.
Crop counts per k vary by 0-4 vertebrae between cells (the matched set depends on the model's own boxes); every paired contrast uses only the vertebrae matched in both arms (n_items, unmatched_a/b).
